_read_me: Built-in rules from the Underwriting Knowledge notes (Oct 2026): Intact ON auto manual 07-02-2026, Jevco ON auto manual 14-07-2026, Intact/Jevco reference chart Jan 2020, Echelon commercial guidelines May 2020, WellCare UW guidelines 2025-07-01.
They cover the driving-record rules only (claims, convictions, cancellations, licence years). Vehicle, use, value and coverage rules still need the manual.
A rule: {"if": {fact: {"min": n, "max": n}}, "when": {...}, "then": verdict, "text": ..., "source": ...}. It applies when every condition is met; min and max include the number itself.

Verdicts: Caution, Refer to underwriter, Not eligible. A market with "applies_to_all": true is checked together with every insurer. "lines": the client folders it is for (Auto, Commercial); "tier": standard, non-standard or commercial (standard markets are recommended first).

Facts: years_licensed, years_insured, years_continuous_insurance, age, at_fault_claims_6y, at_fault_claims_3y, claims_6y, claims_3y, ab_claims_6y, ab_over_10k_6y, ab_claims_10y, open_claims, nonpay_cancellations_3y, nonpay_cancellations_5y, possible_gaps, gap_last_12m, minor_convictions_3y, major_convictions_3y, serious_convictions_3y, alcohol_convictions_3y, major_serious_3y (major + serious), all_convictions_3y (minor + major + serious).

markets.name: Intact (standard auto)
markets.note: Counts are for the principal operator. Also declined by Intact: 6+ minor convictions across all drivers, value $250K+, right-hand drive, lapse while driving.
